description.raw: '''Passive:''' ''[[File:Syndra Dark Sphere.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Dark Sphere|An icon for Syndra's ability Dark Sphere]] [[Syndra#Dark Sphere|Dark Sphere's]]'' cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of [[File:Cooldown reduction icon.png|15px|link=Ability haste]] ability haste.
description.text: Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of  ability haste.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Syndra''' conjures 3 ''[[File:Syndra Dark Sphere.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Dark Sphere|An icon for Syndra's ability Dark Sphere]] [[Syndra#Dark Sphere|Dark Spheres]]'' and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected ''Dark Spheres'', each dealing magic damage upon hit.
description2.text: Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.

description3.raw: The ''[[File:Syndra Dark Sphere.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Dark Sphere|An icon for Syndra's ability Dark Sphere]] [[Syndra#Dark Sphere|Dark Spheres]]'' will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds.
description3.text: The Dark Spheres will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds.

description4.raw: '''[[File:Syndra Transcendent.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Transcendent|An icon for Syndra's ability Transcendent]] [[Syndra#Transcendent|Transcendent]] Bonus:''' Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances ''Unleashed Power'' to [[File:Death from Below.png|20px|link=Kill#Execute|An icon representing the keyword Execute]] [[:Kill#Execute|execute]] the target if it would damage them to below [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 15% of their '''maximum''' health.
description4.text: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below  15% of their maximum health.

notes.raw: * ''Unleashed Power's'' effect takes place at the start of the cast time. ** Additionally, ''Unleashed Power'' cannot be interrupted by any means, including death or [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]]. ''Unleashed Power'' will complete its effect so long as '''Syndra''' has initiated its cast. * Casting ''Unleashed Power'' on a target that becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] while the ''spheres'' are in flight will not destroy them but will invalidate their effects. * ''Spheres'' already in flight will still travel if '''Syndra's''' target dies, but any remaining ''spheres'' will not. However, their duration will still get reset. * A ''sphere'' summoned very shortly before ''Unleashed Power'' '''will''' be used as one of the spheres that get thrown. ** Depending on how many ''spheres'' are on the map and how far away the enemy is upon casting ''Unleashed Power'' it is possible that '''Syndra''' would conjure the ''sphere'' behind her as if she was going to throw it, but she won't. * ''Unleashed Power'' will not add a ''Sphere'' that '''Syndra''' is holding with [[File:Syndra Force of Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Force of Will|An icon for Syndra's ability Force of Will]] [[Syndra#Force of Will|Force of Will]]. * ''Spheres'' that are being pushed by [[File:Syndra Scatter the Weak.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Scatter the Weak|An icon for Syndra's ability Scatter the Weak]] [[Syndra#Scatter the Weak|Scatter the Weak]] (normally ones that were made late during the push) will not get picked up for ''Unleashed Power''. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only block the damage of a single ''sphere''.
notes.text:
Unleashed Power's effect takes place at the start of the cast time.
* Additionally, Unleashed Power cannot be interrupted by any means, including death or resurrection. Unleashed Power will complete its effect so long as Syndra has initiated its cast.
Casting Unleashed Power on a target that becomes untargetable while the spheres are in flight will not destroy them but will invalidate their effects.
Spheres already in flight will still travel if Syndra's target dies, but any remaining spheres will not. However, their duration will still get reset.
A sphere summoned very shortly before Unleashed Power will be used as one of the spheres that get thrown.
* Depending on how many spheres are on the map and how far away the enemy is upon casting Unleashed Power it is possible that Syndra would conjure the sphere behind her as if she was going to throw it, but she won't.
Unleashed Power will not add a Sphere that Syndra is holding with Force of Will.
Spheres that are being pushed by Scatter the Weak (normally ones that were made late during the push) will not get picked up for Unleashed Power.
Spell shield will only block the damage of a single sphere.
